278155781.description:
Natural Mineral Specimen Lot - 2 Pieces
Amethyst and Titanium Aura Quartz
Vintage Collection
This two-piece mineral collection features distinct geological specimens prized for their crystalline structure and color. The lot includes a classic natural amethyst cluster and a treated aura quartz specimen, representing both natural formations and enhanced mineral aesthetics popular in mid-century and modern lapidary collections.
Pieces Included:
Natural Amethyst Cluster - Approximately 3 inches wide, featuring deep purple crystalline points on a natural rocky matrix base.
Titanium Aura Quartz Cluster - Approximately 2.5 inches wide, featuring a metallic iridescent coating with rainbow hues of gold, purple, and blue over a crystal base.
Condition:
Both specimens are in excellent vintage condition. The crystal points are well-defined with no significant post-extraction damage. Natural matrix variations and surface textures are consistent with authentic mineral specimens. No visible repairs or synthetic reconstructions.
Thank you for all of your support!

Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 2.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, centered around a large clear-to-cloudy quartz crystal cluster. The assortment includes a white satin spar (selenite) wand, a clear faceted quartz point, and an array of polished tumbled stones in a spectrum of colors including blue, pink, purple, and earth tones. Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors

The tumbled stones have a smooth, high-polish finish. The quartz cluster shows minor contact marks and natural inclusions typical of geological specimens.
